notes.title: Update 6.0.13: Cooking Simulator Winter Update & Sale
notes.content:
Hi Chefs! 👨‍🍳

We hope you're enjoying the holidays! On our end, we've got a special treat for you: our winter update!

This update includes a new feature and many bug fixes, so check out the summary in the image below, or keep reading for the juicy details!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/deaeebd029766919482ee2e99354a88de87a5c2a.jpg


Sushi DLC Update: Gotcha Shop

The most significant change we've made is introducing the Gotcha Shop in the Sushi DLC! This feature unlocks after you reach the maximum player level (i.e., achieving Black Belt). Here, you can buy points for the Gotcha! App. We hope this will help players unlock all of the recipes in the Sushi DLC and fully experience all that it has to offer.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/473bf14fb30f70ac0d09a68237aaba447e7ca661.png

Bug Fixes 

The fun doesn't stop with the Gotcha Shop though. We've thoroughly seasoned this version of the game with several bug fixes! Keep reading to learn about what's changed:

General

 Improved Vsync functionality
 Added Winter Theme to the main menu background and music

Base Game

 “A winner!” achievement will unlock properly now, only after receiving 1st place in a contest
 Fixed score calculation for contest mode
 It should now be possible to upgrade recipes with Custom Menu enabled
 The following recipes have had their criteria and/or descriptions updated to facilitate obtaining a 5-star rating when cooking them:
   
 Fruit Salad
 Cowboy Steak with Baked Potato and Broccoli
 Grilled Cabbage Burger
 Chicken Pumpkin Stew
 Chicken Pumpkin Stew with Tomatoes
 Orange Pork Stir-Fry
 Pork Chops with Fried Egg and Lemon Baked Potatoes
 Chunky Gazpacho
 Ukrainian Borscht
 Pork Chops and Lemon Baked Potatoes
 Honey-Mustard Burger with French Fries
 Duck Breast with Apples
 Currant-Glazed Pork Tenderloin with Red Cabbage and Thyme Dumplings
 Ukrainian Borscht with Boiled Egg
 Sweet and Sour Pork
 Marinated Sweet and Sour Pork


Sushi DLC

 Added a gacha points shop app that unlocks after reaching max level in career mode - you can now buy points to unlock remaining recipes (as mentioned previously)
 Vege Kanpyo Abo recipe can now be unlocked in Gotcha! App
 Fixed a bug that caused icons in the recipes list in Gotcha! App to not display sometimes
 Improved customer feedback for served dishes in day end summary
 Improved pouring of loose products (e.g., rice)
 Dish summary improvements
 Tweaks to the pace of progression
 Fixed a bug that caused “Recipe unlocked” notifications to show when they should not
 Maki should display correct heat treatment for fried mackerel
 Inedible items should no longer be destroyed in the process of making tempura
 Equalized the rewards for recipes served for special clients and regular clients

Pizza DLC

 Zucchini will no longer fall through all surfaces
 Improved visibility for hovered buttons in Perk App
 Fixed bug where homemade sauce text was not localized properly
 Avocado, Bell peppers, and Eggplant spawners should display properly regardless of which DLCs are purchased

Cakes & Cookies DLC

 Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause a white square to cover half of the phone screen

Shelter DLC

 Fixed a bug that would cause multiple, various issues that was triggered by entering context at the end of the day


What's a holiday without a gift?

Are you still hungry for more? Don't worry, we've got some dessert for you too! To celebrate the holidays, we're offering massive discounts on Cooking Simulator and all of the DLC!
Give the gift of cooking to a friend, or complete your collection and buy any DLC you've been interested in. We hope that everyone enjoys the holidays and the new year!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3df3364a634a132680aa42b9594c3e9172b2049c.jpg

Community Feedback in Action: Join us on Discord

After reviewing the results of our recent survey and your feedback, we're prioritizing updates that reflect what matters most to you. Over the next few months, we’ll be focusing on fixing bugs, reworking some core mechanics and adding new content inspired by your suggestions.

Some of these changes are already in development, so stay tuned for more updates. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and we're looking forward to hearing more of your ideas.

If you'd like your voice to be heard or hear the latest news, we encourage you to join our Discord server to share your feedback, report bugs or get some sneak peeks of what's coming to Cooking Simulator. We've recently refreshed our Discord server to better serve you, and hope to see you there sharing your Cooking Simulator experience with us and the community. Your feedback helps us make Cooking Simulator better for everyone.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4c12181ba6b810a3e99e123ca5e7412d5f51a77c.gif

Happy Holidays!

We wish you a joyful holiday season and a fantastic New Year. Thank you for being part of our community—we’re looking forward to an exciting year ahead together!

From all of us at Big Cheese Studio
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and Happy New Year!

notes.title: SUSHI BARS: Tamagoyaki 🍳🥚🥞

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/a627e9c4dc1c76c6dc1c461cce575f383dae7b2f.jpg

Hi Chefs! 👨‍🍳

Do you know how to prepare a Japanese omelette – tamagoyaki? It’s going to be one of the new recipes in our upcoming DLC - Cooking Simulator: Sushi! 🍳🥢

notes.title: Poltergeist multiplayer mode available for beta testing!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b2bea75237b5659f0c8a0a5d3a91506f0a0c83aa.png

Hi Chefs!

Winter Holiday is just around the corner! To help you celebrate that special time of the year usually spent bonding with each other, we'd like to invite you to check out the beta version of the Poltergeist Multiplayer mode.

Yes, you've heard that right. Poltergeist is a holiday-themed multiplayer mode for Cooking Simulator. Just keep in mind that it's still in a very early beta stage, so  definitely expect some bugs while messing around with your friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/04ae0c51dede2a13c301d0dfdc8e15e203a9f481.jpg


How to access beta:
1. Right-click on 'Cooking Simulator' in your Steam library and go to 'Properties'
2. In the new window left-click ‘BETAS’ from the left side panel
3. Choose ‘poltergeist’ from the drop-down list
4. Close the window and update the game

IMPORTANT: The beta contains only the Poltergeist game mode! If you want to access the regular Cooking Simulator game modes, you’ll need to opt out from beta. By using the instruction above, choose ‘none’ from the drop-down list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/82c98d25f0cde99263f53a9f04ccbb471f3a6b53.png


Poltergeist Multiplayer mode allows for up to 4 players sharing the Classic kitchen and preparing dishes. You'll see each other as friendly ghosts flying across the kitchen. Due to the game's nature some of the interactions are limited. You can cooperate by exchanging products and ready made-dishes by using the shared space on the table right in the middle of the kitchen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d1026a03c52e54288a4e32b0f6152310ba753bf1.jpg


Poltergeist offers 2 game modes:
Sandbox - learn and practice your cooking skills with any pressure or scoring
Leaderboards - work together to prepare the chosen dishes during the given time and earn the highest score possible


If you'd like to share some feedback or find other players to cook with, make sure to join our official discord server:
discord.gg/bigcheesestudio

Have fun cooking together!

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #6 | Quests and NPCs
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/08743c3450d38bc794dde9b6b1d3429959e8ab9e.png

Hi Chefs!

This is the final entry in the devlog series. This time we'll focus on the quests, NPCs and camps in the game.

As a reminder Shelter will be available on November 18 with a nice -15% launch discount! 
Add to your wishlist and don't miss the release!

Also, if you've missed previous entries here's a list of all the Shelter devlogs and their topics:
 Shelter Devlog #5 | Caravan
 Shelter Devlog #4 | Cooking and recipes
 Shelter Devlog #3 | Hunting and farming
 Shelter Devlog #2 | Underground chambers
 Shelter Devlog #1 | Inspirations and lore


As you might already know in Shelter you'll be playing as a chef looking for their lost family in the wastelands. After arriving at a place known as Sector 12 you stumble upon an abandoned military comm center. The last hope lies in restoring the radio towers and hopefully contacting our loved ones. Unfortunately we won't be able to fix the radios without the help of nearby settlements and that's where our cooking skills come in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/0c706bd2d7c3fa9b41e88753f6263021a154cb34.png


Throughout the game we'll complete quests for the 4 camps in the Sector and the caravan who will be the first group of people we'll meet. The camps and their inhabitants are quite diversified. Aside from the nomadic merchant group represented by Mila Run, there are the cattle breeders family from MacStump's ranch, mutated miners of Stedler Camp, survivors operating in a steelworks facility in Firepit Plant and finally the remnants from the former military base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4b41f11ae70eb52b7bcf414677313ddf3d308b49.png


Each group has a leader who'll be giving us varios quests which will eventually lead to mutual trust. The caravan will help us deliver and exchange goods required by each settlement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/bdc11c8e2d5e82e77607bd29be115e4d6e6cc767.png


Quests unlock various rewards such as resources, gun upgrades, new recipes and so on. Completing the final quest for each settlement will grant us the special parts needed for repairing the radio towers. In case we find ourselves in need of some extra cash or other supplies we can take up to 3 additional side-quests each day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9449d32ea3028a13d416b24b640a9f758dd75f7e.png


As for the quests themselves, we wanted to introduce new challenges, different from a strict list of orders to complete. A few examples might be delivering enough highly radioactive food for the mutated miners, preparing cow forage with medicines for MacStumps or preparing food rations and killing mutated rats near our shed to help expeditors from the military base crossing nearby.


How do you like the ideas for the new content? Let us know in the comments.

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #5 | Caravan
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/dee1d32fbcac63c32ea40586585b13b77c1b7bf9.png

Hi Chefs!

Shelter is getting closer to the release and very soon we'll be able to give you an exact date!

In the previous devlogs you've learned about the new ingredients, recipes, gathering resources and the new environment. Despite all those completely new mechanics, Shelter is still first and foremost a cooking game. It's also NOT an open world game. All the trading, exchanging resources and contacting other settlements is made possible thanks to the caravan travelling across the sector.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9a085bd202f83f92e8fe67d97d65c05a6c51e14e.png


The caravan leader Mila Run will be one of the first people we'll encounter in the Sector. She'll be giving you the first quests that will allow you to build mutual trust. Eventually she'll introduce us to the leaders of other settlers who should be able to help us restore the radio towers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/dd7669a0c40a12b001b8cf601790282de861332e.png


There are 4 different settlements in the Sector but none are not going to help a complete stranger so before asking for any favors we'll need to do something for them. The quests will vary from cooking for a feast to preparing fodder for carnivorous cows. That's where our cooking skills, resourcefulness and shelter's equipment come in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3dd7d9e455c63f7627c8b62b49d9a963e5e1bdec.png

By the end of each day in Shelter you'll be visited by the travelling merchants. They'll collect and deliver all the food we've prepared and also exchange products and other supplies necessary for cooking and surviving in the wasteland.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5ac4cb6a14fb45e29cdfacc9a8f63a4650c614ac.png


Wastelands can be quite unpredictable and you might find yourself in need of some extra items you haven't bought in advance. In such cases, you can use the radio to contact the caravan and request an express delivery. Just keep in mind that you'll need to pay extra for such a favor!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5c2cdbc8f0be7e50314b56e004aa1198c2dace17.jpg

Hi Chefs!

In the previous devlog we surprised some of you with the new mechanics such as hunting and farming. In this entry we'd like to talk a little bit about cooking and recipes, because Shelter is still first and foremost a cooking game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/07cfb0e04d34843c16eebbca15d3b6310f60b375.jpg


In Shelter you'll need to utilize your cooking skills to earn trust from the surrounding camps in the Sector and with their help try to find your long lost family. Cooking in the post-apocalypse will be based on ~60 unique food products. That includes meat harvested from 3 types of mutants, monster eggs, mutated plants and mushrooms and various pre-war products such as sauces, spices or multiple canned products. We wanted to see the expansion's setting as an opportunity to introduce tasty and exotic-looking foods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/120e72d9e7cb5edde5ec3841e8aaa0a84f3c5ddb.jpg


New products also mean completely new recipes. Surviving in the wastelands requires high levels of creativity and making the most out of available resources. Shelter's cookbook will include a total of 45 recipes with varying levels of complexity. On the post-nuclear menu you'll be able to find all kinds of dishes from soups, stews and burgers to completely new dishes based partially on Turkish cuisine. New types of recipes include shashlik, kebabs and vegetables on a stick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b54c994e31c6851b78437a3edf9835df53f542e6.jpg


Shelter will be equipped with various tools and stands you might know already from the base game. That means ovens, griddles, cookers, pots, pans, knives, blenders all reskinned to match the theme of the game. There will be some new utensils as well. First one is the pipette which should make all the drizzling a bit easier and the second one is a huge BBQ grill placed in the middle of the kitchen. The BBQ grill will be used for preparing all the new skewer-based dishes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/fc1f8ccd63392297b1d3da41730ff875ff8d3695.jpg

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #3 | Hunting and farming
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b91cb06c4dddc7ce6488c44c0ccd1f6da3e216ed.jpg

Hi Chefs!

Shelter release is just around the corner. Below is the latest devlog dedicated to some of the new mechanics - hunting and farming!

As you might already know, Shelter due to its post-apocalyptic setting is all about being resourceful and making the most out of every opportunity and scarce resources. That's why keeping the old mechanics of instantly buying everything we might need for cooking wouldn't make that much sense in the barren wastelands.

The food products can be obtained in one of 3 ways:

 hunting mutants and harvesting their meat 
 growing plants in an underground farm 
 ordering additional products from the caravan travelling across the Sector


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3e86d50074c3e06909911bb4291a3c39e23f0460.png

The main source of protein will be the meat harvested from 3 species of mutants roaming the desert: rats, armadillos and vultures. During the day we can climb to the shed above our shelter and use it as a hunting range. Shooting is definitely a mechanic you wouldn't expect from a Cooking Simulator game but we tried to make it as interesting and engaging as possible. The gun will feature 4 upgrades:

 Scope
 Silencer
 Magazine
 Extended barrel

Those can be unlocked by progressing the accessible immediately in Sandbox mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c80f7099c8167ccbfebf4838f79708389d375d46.png

Some quests might require us to maintain the mutants' population at a certain level. Killing too many might result in reduced numbers and longer time required to repopulate again. Mutants can be attracted by using makeshift lures which will attract certain types of creatures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7299be53d10f3e2486dbeee6b9f81303417beba9.png

Meat is not the only type of food available in the wastelands. As mentioned in one of the previous entries, we wanted to look at the post-apocalyptic setting as an opportunity to introduce intriguing, colorful and vibrant plant-based foods. The following products can be grown in the underground farm:

 Broccoli
 Leek
 Cactus
 Celery
 Tomato
 Carrot
 Blue mushroom
 Red mushroom
 Green mushroom 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c74400dd3414a86e91206c6ad5955973bafba0cc.png

After planting the seeds, watering and using optional boosters there's a 1-day long growing period after which the plants are ready for harvest. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/2ea3b6cb499af425977e7dc0685f3b0639a5d6c9.png

Unfortunately one of the side effects of living in an irradiated wasteland are random mutations which can turn our seeds into carnivorous plants. In such a case, the only thing left to do is grabbing our gun to clear the spot for future plants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f326825a19e8840b0a043f49bac3a894d11288a3.png

There are a lot of recipes to master and most of them require more products than can be obtained on our own. The initial supplies can be restocked with the help of the caravan travelling across the Sector.

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #1 | Inspirations and lore ☢️
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f01ead2b9a811b15ac585fbc9ed2259cc84a48e3.png

Hi Chefs!

As promised, here's the first entry in the series of posts describing in detail the process of creating this post-nuclear expansion. We'll start off by giving you some insight on the inspirations for the DLC.

When coming up with ideas for new content after Pizza, we quickly decided that we wanted to try a more unusual approach to cooking. Post-apocalyptic setting provided a great opportunity for introducing uncanny mutated food products prepared using unconventional culinary solutions and an environment you wouldn’t normally expect in a cooking game. Obviously, in such a world, a skilled cook able to provide good quality nutritious food would always be in high demand. Plus, a post-apocalypse is simply an awesome setting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/fe0b96a3dfefb826814e7658b5852c72199c5206.png


After initial research focused on various great movies, books and games we created the first concept arts. The vast desert wastelands of Mad Max had the biggest influence on the new environment. The teal and orange color palette of scorched soil and blue skies above were the look we started to aim for with the surface world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ac41156cebcd70592d7ea0dddfd20b379d8b5e9b.png


Mushroom farm concept served as an inspiration for various edible plants created by the radiation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/288bd7c31a7448c2a9d9ea3ecb5f4a998c90dde0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/87e61f46483c8e7a620dc3f6633d043064c32d1e.png


The expansion is called Shelter for a reason. When it comes to underground bunkers, the biggest influence comes, obviously, from the Fallout (and less obviously from real-life submarine interiors). Unlike the Fallout Vaults though, we wanted our shelter to be equipped with various cooking utensils. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7dab7196bb4a55120832098ec709a42672abf054.png


That’s why we focused on repurposing different everyday items from the late 1980s to be used for cooking roughly 46 years after the nuclear apocalypse. Metro 2033 is a great example of a franchise with interesting designs, where people tinker with mundane items to survive in the Moscow metro 20 years after the war that put their world to an end.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3dd75cc236659c6dbba7f48f8edcb3d7e0339f60.png


Initially we had 2 ideas for the basic plot and story in the game. In the first one you’d be a member of an underground shelter cooking for a community gathered inside before the bombs fell until the outside world is safe to live again. The second idea, the one we finally took on, was being a skilled cook living in the wastelands looking for their lost family. This plot allowed for introducing more interactions with other settlements, resulting in more diverse quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/002b151a352b9c185106e5270a4049a90c3bbc84.png


In the next Devlog we’ll have a deeper look at some of the new mechanics such as hunting and growing food. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Cooking Simulator Roadmap
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9e8c833fe92fce768e54e8ef01f3984fd696ef1c.png

Hi Chefs!

The dev team is hard at work to constantly improve Cooking Simulator. Today we want to shed some light on things that we are up to and when to expect them. 

This is why we're very excited to present to you the Cooking Simulator Roadmap. First in a series of announcements spotlighting features and content currently under development. It's also a way of letting you know when to expect new content and important messages.

THE ROADMAP
Today's spotlight is on two major content updates coming to the game for FREE in the next few weeks! But before you scroll down to learn the details, mark down 6th of December in your calendars. That's the date of our next big announcement!

- What about features that aren't on the list? Does this mean you aren't working on anything else? - Rest assured, we're exploring all kinds of different topics - from bugfixing, through optimisation, new content, new game modes to entirely new ways to experience Cooking Simulator. What we decide to share through the roadmap are features that we can put a specific timeframe on. We don't want to tease you too much ;)

MODERN KITCHEN
Many of you have spent hours upon hours in Cooking Simulator's kitchen and you need a change - we hear you! Staying in one place for too long can have it's toll. So on 21st of November we'll introduce a new location to hang out and cook all that delicious food. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/78454547dabb5b0324d0da08d2b3514883e61cbc.jpg

Tired of the same old brick walls and all the noise coming from the streets? Try the Modern Kitchen - a new fancy place located in a luxury skyscraper, detached from the racket of the city. Modern Kitchen will become available in career and sandbox modes (requires starting a new game) as a FREE update to the game.

LEADERBOARD CHALLENGE
Ever wanted to prove that you are the best chef around? Well, soon you will be able to! Pick an order from all the dishes available in the game and take to the kitchen. No distractions, just one simple goal - serve the best dish you can, the fastest you can. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/adb7e7ceed4ef6a9f745123bc0919f996ad1618b.png

Based on this performance, the game will calculate your score and place you on a leaderboard. Each recipe will have its own leaderboard. Become an expert in one or master them all. Rivalry begins on 4th of December with a FREE update to the game.

SECRET ANNOUNCEMENT
But that's not all! We have another very important announcement coming for you on December the 6th. Be sure to mark down that date and visit our community page on Steam. We won't tease what we have in store for you - don't want to spoil the surprise, you'll have to be patient. But feel free to speculate in comments, on the forums and on our Discord: https://discord.gg/cookingsimulator

Also be sure to let us know what you think about the upcoming features and this format of revealing them!

Hope you'll have a great time with the new content!
Cooking Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: Cooking Simulator FAQ
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/e5e6277f5f1f713f7c754b36c2ac7fff14274627.png
Hey Chefs!
Below you can find answers to some of the most commonly asked questions regarding the game and it's future. Please read :)

Cooking Simulator FAQ
1. Are you going to add more content? More dishes, kitchens, utensils, mechanics? DLC?
Yes, of course! Right now our main focus is patching the game and fixing any issues. We're releasing patches frequently so we can start working on extra content ASAP.  We promise to update you with more information regarding new features as soon as we've got any details confirmed. Stay tuned!

1.1 We want a ladde! Are you guys going to add a ladle?
Yes! It's coming sooner than you'd think :)

2. VR?
Right now our main focus is patching the game. We know that you guys would love VR and so do we! As soon as we've got some solid info, we'll let you know.

3. Multiplayer/Co-Op?
We're 100% aware that you guys would love to have it. The game was designed as a single player experience and we'll need to check if and in what form it's possible. We're considering it but we just need a little more time before we can say anything for sure.

4. More platforms? PS4, XBOX ONE, MAC?
We're considering it but can't confirm anything yet :)

5. Is my PC going to run the game?
Please check the requirements on the Steam store page.
Alternatively, you can use this site: https://www.systemrequirementslab.com/cyri/requirements/cooking-simulator/18846

5.1 How can I check my PC specs?
Follow these steps:
  1. Press Win + R
  2. Type in "dxdiag.exe"
  3. Press Enter

6. I can't save my game/my game is stuck on 'Saving' screen in tutorial, what to do?
Try these possible solutions:

 In most cases, the antivirus is responsible for this. You can turn it off or add a game as an exception
 If the point above doesn't help: Open steam -> Library -> Right Click on Cooking Simulator -> Properties -> Local Files -> Browse local files -> Right Click on CookingSim.exe -> Compatibility -> Check Run this program as an Administrator
 Next go to: Security -> Select your username -> Edit -> Check Full control -> Apply -> Ok
 If the problem still exists, ask the developers. It's best to find us on our discord server: https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM

7. How can I access the latest update?
We publish new patches on the beta branch and once they're approved they're transferred onto the default branch.
How to access the beta branch:
1 .Go to your Steam Library
2. Right-click on Cooking Simulator and select "Properties"
3. Go to the tab marked "Betas"
4. In the drop-down box, select "beta"
5. Wait for the game to finish updating, you should see the branch name listed after the game name.

8. I need some tech support!
Feel free to talk to us on our official discord server. We usually need some more info before we can start working on a fix for you.
https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM

9. I've found a translation error! Where can I report it?
The best place is our discord server: https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM
Great guys from our community are proofreading all the translations. Feel free to join them :)

10. Are there going to be more languages available?
Yes! Currently we're working on Japanese. Also, our lovely community is preparing Czech, Dutch, Hungarian and Lithuanian <3

11. How can I add my own radio stations or music?
You can add radio stations by pasting URL in the Audio settings. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/b0aed5bf93c37d80fd57f3c79741e21ca71321c0.png
Follow this video on how to get the URL: https://youtu.be/giz9eOSubgY
You can play your own music by pasting it's folder path in audio settings or by pasting the files into the path shown on the screen above.

12. I can't flip stuff! Can you help me?
The game mechanics require some getting used to. You flip either in context mode or manually by holding shift and rotating the spatula. You can also buy a Heatproof Gloves perk and do it with your bare hands.
Here's a video on how to flip using the spatula: https://youtu.be/iA-AtLsTqaU

13. How can I support the game?
First of all, we're glad to hear you're enjoying the game! The best way to support us is by leaving Cooking Simulator a positive review on Steam. This will allow us to add more stuff to the game sooner :)

In case you have some more questions, need tech support or you'd like to chat with thousands of other players, feel free to join our discord server:
https://discord.gg/7m8UZyM

Best regards,
Cooking Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: Release in 1 week! Major announcement!
notes.content:
Cooking Simulator will be available on Steam on June 6th!
The game's coming next week and we couldn't be more excited for the release. 
The whole team has been working very hard every single day to deliver the best game possible for all of us to enjoy. In the recent months, thanks to your feedback and suggestions, there have been added some major improvements to the game. Below you can see the list of all the features.

COOKING MECHANICS BASED ON REALISTIC PHYSICS
First of all, this game is not a "clicker". Whenever you're cooking or fooling around, there's always physics applied in the background. When making french fries, the potatoes split exactly at the cut line. Steaks on the griddle fry exactly where they touch it's surface. Food can be blended and turned into liquid. Liquids can mix together, change colour, temperature and exchange flavours. In fact all the food exchanges flavour all the time in the process. The dishes you make are being rated based on correct technique, temperature, ingredient proportions and preparation time.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/e17bdbd9d59706aa5ab8d6fc569b808aaebbdff5.gif

COOKING SCHOOL
It is basically a set of short tutorials. The game's got a learning curve and the mechanics need a tiny bit of time to get used to. The optional tutorials should make your start as painless as possible :)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/5ea47edf40372fbaa85190c77dcd9f3227b56de5.gif

CAREER MODE
You'll start your cooking career as a new chef in a restaurant that didn't perform so well in the past. After the first introductional days (don't worry, they're totally skippable!), you'll start serving dishes on your own. At first you'll have only 3 positions in the menu but as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new more advanced recipes. Your goal is to reach  5 Fame Stars. Once you reach top fame level, you can continue playing to unlock all the recipes and win all competitions or you can start a new career to see how well you'd do with other perks and skills selected.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/a850b1485d38eb66bd064c7326bdae9b61e86309.gif

CAREER PROGRESS
In order to progress, you'll need to do multiple tasks at once and deliver on time various well-made dishes. While climbing the culinary ladder, you'll need to mind your finances. Money allows you to buy ingredients and new utensils but it is also used to pay for necessary repairs of broken stands. For chefs who do well financially there's even an option to redecorate the kitchen! Well served guests will happily tip you but in case you really mess up, they might ask for a refund! 
You'll also have to please food critics and complete day-long cooking events. Each day you can complete simple Daily Quests for some EXP boost. There are total 20 experience levels that allow you to select perks and skills. Perks are active abilities that have huge impact on the gameplay while skills have a more subtle passive influence.
Throughout the career you'll be able to unlock over 60 dishes and over 120 ingredients (products, liquids, spices and herbs). 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/211b8c414a76881cb2abdd99044811561d448f69.gif

SANDBOX MODE
For those of you who need instant access to all the good stuff, who don't like to be bothered by hungry customers or clocks ticking and for those of you who just want to goof around with absolutely no consequences we've got the Sandbox Mode. You can do virtually WHATEVER you want in this mode. 

 Try out every single recipe? Check! 
 Use any ingredients to create something unique? Ingenious culinary inventions or disgusting deep fried monstrosities? Check! 
 Play with lifelike physics and do all the things you couldn't or shouldn't even try to do in your own kitchen? Blow up the oven and set the floor on fire? Check! 
 Mess with the gravity and make all the mess you've made float around like it's outer space? Well... Check!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/2c54796a07634def8b883a34b87052dc0488aa3e.gif

IMPORTANT INFO

 Upon release the game will be available in the following languages: English, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, French, Italian, Korean and Turkish
 On the day of release we'll be running 24h developer stream with the whole team. We hope to have some good time playing the game with you. Let us know, how much you're excited for the idea!
 We'll continue to support the game during and after the release. We'll do our best to help you as much as we can with any issues you might encounter. Later on, we'll start working on more content depending on your responses end expectations :)


tl'dr 
Cooking Simulator is coming on Thursday June 6th at the price of $19.99 and we're super excited for the release!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29063568/bd2060d9522aa76f3ff70c84eb70c1ff8a17fcad.gif
See you soon,
Cooking Simulator Dev Team

notes.title: Updated FAQ
notes.content:
We're posting new videos and screenshots almost every day. 
Our social media:
Facebook:https://www.facebook.com/CookingSimulator/
Twitter:https://twitter.com/cookingsim

Cooking Simulator FAQ🤔:

1. When is the game going to be released?
We’re aiming for PC Steam release in early 2019.

2. Game requirements?
You can find them on the Steam store page.


3. Other platforms? VR?
The game’s going to be released additionally on PS4 and XBOX ONE but the exact release date is yet to be announced. The VR might be added after the release but nothing has been confirmed so far.

4. Language versions?
The game is going to be released in: English, Polish, German, Spanish, Russian and Chinese. We might add some additional translations depending on the demand.

5. Price?
Affordable. As soon as we get everything confirmed, we’ll post an update.

6. Beta/early access?
Some time ago we’ve closed beta access. We’ve received tons of constructive and positive feedback. Right now, according to your valuable advice, we’re focused on polishing the game, so we can deliver the full and complete product for you on 6th of December.

7. Game modes?
The game is going to include 3 game modes:
- Career mode with 5 levels of fame to achieve 
- Cooking School, a full game tutorial
- Sandbox mode where you can freely access full game content and do whatever you want

8. What kinds of dishes are going to be featured in the game?
We would like to make the meals quite common, so you can easily prepare them by yourself in your real kitchen after playing the game, but yeah, we might add some regional touch after a while.
The game is going to include over 120 ingredients and products and over 60 recipes to unlock.

9. Multiplayer?
We’re focused on single player experience. It's something we'll consider post-release bacause of on multiple requests.

10. Is this going to be a goofy game?
This really depends on the player. We wanted to make THE Cooking Simulator, where all the cooking is taken very seriously and player can get a glimpse of being a real chef. But on the other hand, if you want to play around and try to do all the things you couldn’t do in real life, well, there’s nothing there to stop you :) 

11. How can I support the game?
The best way to support Cooking Simulator is by adding to your Steam Wishlist.
The more people on the Wishlist, the higher chances we have to appear on Steam’s upcoming games list and main store page.
You can also help by telling your friends about the game ;)

notes.title: Update on release date
notes.content:

Based on it, we've decided to take a little more time to properly polish the game. As we've always said, we want to deliver a complete and enjoyable product that we can all be proud of.

- over 60 dishes to unlock
- over 120 ingredients and products
- Career mode with 5 levels of fame to achieve  
- Cooking School, a full game tutorial
- Sandbox mode where you can freely access full game content and do whatever you want
